executive_summary: The automated test report for the web application indicates significant functional and security issues. While smoke tests passed successfully, several functional tests failed, and critical security headers are missing, which could expose the application to vulnerabilities.

ai_issues.title: Missing CSP header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Content Security Policy (CSP) header is not implemented.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without CSP, the application is vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, which could lead to data breaches.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement a CSP header to define approved sources of content.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set.
ai_issues.business_impact: This could allow MIME type sniffing, potentially leading to security vulnerabilities.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the X-Content-Type-Options header with the value 'nosniff'.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Frame-Options header is not set.
ai_issues.business_impact: This could allow clickjacking attacks, compromising user interactions.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the X-Frame-Options header with the value 'DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN'.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Referrer-Policy header is not set.
ai_issues.business_impact: This could lead to unintended information leakage via the Referer header.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Referrer-Policy header to control the information sent in the Referer header.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Permissions-Policy header is not set.
ai_issues.business_impact: This could allow the use of browser features without explicit permission.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement a Permissions-Policy header to restrict the use of browser features.

ai_issues.title: Failed environment update with valid JWT
ai_issues.root_cause: The server returned a 400 status code instead of the expected 200.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users are unable to update their environment settings, affecting application usability.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Investigate server-side validation and ensure the API handles valid JWTs correctly.

ai_issues.title: Dashboard access denied
ai_issues.root_cause: The server returned a 403 status code instead of the expected 200.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users cannot access the dashboard, severely impacting user experience.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Review access control settings and ensure valid users can access the dashboard.

ai_issues.title: Sign-in page access denied
ai_issues.root_cause: The server returned a 403 status code instead of the expected 200.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users are unable to sign in, preventing access to the application.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Ensure the sign-in page is accessible and properly configured to handle redirects.

ai_issues.title: Homepage access denied
ai_issues.root_cause: The server returned a 403 status code instead of the expected 200.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users cannot access the homepage, affecting the initial user interaction with the application.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Check resource identifiers and permissions to ensure the homepage is accessible.

ai_issues.title: Main page access denied
ai_issues.root_cause: The server returned a 403 status code instead of the expected 200.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users cannot access the main page, hindering overall application usage.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Verify access permissions and server configurations for the main page.

positive_findings: All smoke tests passed successfully, indicating basic functionality is intact.
No visual issues were detected, suggesting the UI is rendering correctly.
The application has a low average response time, indicating good performance.
priority_actions: Implement the missing Content Security Policy (CSP) header to mitigate XSS risks.
Fix the access control issues causing 403 errors on the dashboard, sign-in, homepage, and main page.
Ensure the environment update API correctly handles valid JWTs and returns the expected status code.
Add the X-Content-Type-Options header to prevent MIME type sniffing.
Add the X-Frame-Options header to protect against clickjacking attacks.
